hook: A quantum photon counter can see finite irreversibility while the true entropy production is infinite.
summary: The author builds a model of a parametric oscillator coupled to a vacuum bath, where forward and reverse processes cannot overlap, so microscopic entropy production diverges. A realistic photon counter with imperfect efficiency and dark counts still reports a finite, positive arrow of time. This is a proof on a constructed model, not an experiment.
title: Finite Measured Entropy Production Does Not Imply Finite Microscopic Irreversibility
